H0.style: A warm, composed daytime radio news presenter telling a human-interest story: clear, credible and approachable, with a smile in the voice. Group words into meaningful phrases, keep the phrasing smooth and connected, and breathe naturally between ideas.
H0.note: TRIAL-02 H0 Take1再利用(再生成なし)

J01.style: A warm, friendly radio presenter telling a human-interest story at about 150 words per minute. Sound clear and smiling, and carry each sentence straight into the next without a long stop.

axes.pause: 文末停止抑制(carry ... without a long stop)

J01.design_intent: 数値WPMがTTSの速度に効くかを検証。Adv現状175-187なので150指定でどこまで下がるか。
J01.expected_side_effects: 数値を無視して速いまま/数値に引かれて間が増える恐れ

J02.style: Speak at a slow, steady 130 words per minute, warm and clear, with a smile in your voice. Do not pause after sentences; let each one roll into the next.

axes.pause: 文末停止禁止(Do not pause)

J02.design_intent: J01より強い数値指定+強い停止抑制。数値の強さ依存(150 vs 130)と相反効果(速度↓でポーズ↑)の検出。
J02.expected_side_effects: 過減速、語尾の引き延ばし、no pauseによる不自然な詰め込み

J03.style: A warm storyteller reading a human-interest story in a measured, deliberate pace, clear and smiling. Let each sentence lead naturally into the next, pausing only briefly at the end of a sentence.

axes.voice: 落ち着いたストーリーテリング

J03.design_intent: measured/deliberateという速度語の強さ検証。slowlyを避けつつ減速できるか。
J03.expected_side_effects: deliberateが文末間・文中間を増やす恐れ(相反)

J04.style: A friendly radio host chatting with one listener in a relaxed, easy tempo. Keep the voice bright and clear, with a smile in it.
J04.design_intent: ポーズ指示なしでテンポ語のみ。会話調だけでペースが落ちるか(TRIAL-02 H2はcalm conversationalでも速かった)。
J04.expected_side_effects: 速度ほぼ不変の可能性、間の挙動はモデル任せ

J05.style: A warm radio presenter, clear and approachable, with a smile in the voice. Never leave a long silence after a sentence: let the end of each sentence glide into the start of the next, as one continuous story.

axes.pause: 文末停止抑制を強く(Never ... long silence / glide)
axes.voice: ラジオニュース調寄り(presenter)

J05.design_intent: ポーズ指示のみの純粋効果(速度指示なし)。文末無音がどこまで短くなり、速度が上がるか(相反効果の観察)。
J05.expected_side_effects: ポーズ短縮で全体が速くなる(目標超過)可能性が高い

J06.style: A friendly storyteller. Link words into long, smooth phrases and keep the voice moving through each clause, taking short natural breaths only at commas and sentence ends.

axes.pause: フレーズ接続強調+息継ぎ位置限定

J06.design_intent: 文中のつながり(フレーズ接続)を強調した時の文中無音・速度への影響。
J06.expected_side_effects: 長いphraseで早口化、息継ぎ位置限定で抑揚が平板になる恐れ

J07.style: A warm, calm radio presenter, bright and clear. Take short, natural breaths between ideas, and never let a breath linger.

axes.pause: 自然な息継ぎ優先(短く)
axes.voice: ラジオニュース調寄り

J07.design_intent: TRIAL-02 H0の『breathe naturally』を一から短く言い換え、息継ぎ指示の最小効果を観察。
J07.expected_side_effects: 速度は元のHに近い=速め傾向の再現の可能性

J08.style: A crisp radio news announcer reading a human-interest story at a calm broadcast pace, clear, credible and warm, with an upbeat smile in the voice. Keep sentence endings short and connected.
J08.design_intent: ニュース調でcalm指定+crispの変化を見る(TRIAL-02 H1のnews-broadcast paceとの対比)。
J08.expected_side_effects: crispが速度を上げる恐れ、硬さで温かみ低下

J09.style: A natural, easygoing narrator speaking to a friend, warm and animated, with lively intonation and a smile in the voice. Talk at a relaxed pace, as if you were just telling someone what you read.

axes.voice: 自然な語りかけ(友人への語り)

J09.design_intent: 最も口語的な像+抑揚(lively intonation)重視。声質(抑揚)への効果と速度の関係を見る。
J09.expected_side_effects: animatedが速度を上げる恐れ、口語で語尾が崩れる恐れ

J10.style: A calm storyteller telling a true story to a small audience, warm and gentle, with expressive intonation. Slow the pace slightly, but keep the silence between sentences short and each ending connected to what follows.

axes.pause: 文末停止抑制(short silence / connected)
axes.voice: 落ち着いたストーリーテリング

J10.design_intent: 減速と文末間短縮を同時に明示し、相反効果を打ち消せるかの本命候補の一つ。
J10.expected_side_effects: slowが文中間・語尾を延ばす、またはbut節で片方が無視される

J11.style: Warm and clear, with a smile. Calm pace, short pauses.
J11.design_intent: 最小限の指示で何が効くか。声質像を省いた時の声質劣化も確認。
J11.expected_side_effects: 声質像が薄くなる。極短Prompt(下限探索、2文)

J12.style: Speak warmly and clearly, with a smile in the voice. Keep a pace of about 150 words per minute, and keep every pause between sentences under half a second.
J12.design_intent: 数値条件(速度+間の上限)の明示が効くかを検証。J01との差で『数値の間指定』の効果を分離。
J12.expected_side_effects: 数値の間指定は無視される可能性、短すぎる間で不自然

J13.style: Read noticeably slower than a news bulletin, warm and bright, with expressive intonation. Between sentences keep the silence very short and let the voice carry on.

axes.speed: 相対速度(noticeably slower than a news bulletin)
axes.pause: 文末の間を非常に短く(very short / carry on)
axes.voice: ラジオニュース調との対比

J13.design_intent: 相対基準で強めに減速+強く間を詰める。強め指示の限界と副作用を見る。
J13.expected_side_effects: 過減速で不自然、または間の抑制が負けて長沈黙

self_check.contradictions: 矛盾なし(J02のslow/no pause、J10/J13の減速+間短縮の併記は相反効果検証のため意図的)
self_check.redundancy: 各Promptは速度/間/声質を各1回ずつ。J11のみ極短(意図)
